item.title: Iran prepared to withstand naval blockade: VP Aref
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Iran’s First Vice President Mohammad Reza Aref says that the country is not concerned about a US-imposed naval blockade, pointing to a significant increase in the unloading and clearance of essential goods through its northern and other non-southern borders.
item.content:encoded:
